title: Sr. BA II
description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
  
  
**Job Description**
Invesco understands data and the products created from data are the lifeblood of our business. Data-first functions work together seamlessly to enable Invesco to achieve the true value of data and data products. Invesco leverages data as a strategic asset by making quality, trusted data and content available to the right people, at the right time, in the right format, in the most efficient way possible to enable both large transformations and day-to-day operations.
  
  
This Senior Business Analyst role sits within the Product Engagement part of our Digital, Distribution and Enterprise Engineering (D2E2) organization. They maintain good relationships with internal partners and collaborate with their peers across the Distribution business domain. They develop a strong understanding of the investments and distribution data and business processes, including both how it is produced and consumed across all Distribution channels and how to apply Invesco’s Data strategy and practices to drive Distribution’s data capabilities forward.
  
  
The focus of this position is to work closely with the business units to gain in-depth understanding of customer's business strategy, processes, services, roadmap and the context in which the business operates. This role will be key to understanding and documenting capabilities needed to address business challenges. Under the general supervision, gather business and data requirements, convert the business and data requirements into technical requirements for solution development. The senior business analyst supports the product owner(s) in managing the scope of the assigned project(s), resolves any impediments from requirements perspective for development team, supports the system testing and user acceptance testing. The business analyst also performs validation of deliverables against requirements ensuring that solution is meeting the objectives.
  
  
You will be responsible for:
  

* The Senior Business Analyst is responsible for reviewing assigned business processes from end-to-end to identify and address operational, financial and technological risks.
* Analyzing and understanding the end-to-end Distribution processes and the data associated with multiple business processes having cross domain.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency.
* Responsibilities will include a full range of activities from leading small to mid-size projects to assisting product owners on larger more complex projects.
* Under the guidance of the product owners, the senior business analyst should be able to work with business stakeholders to document the functional and non-functional requirements.
* Conducts interviews to gather customer requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Translates conceptual customer requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is understandable to developers/project team.
* Demonstrate strong Problem-solving skills.
* Attending regular team and other required meetings daily/weekly.
* Ensuring clear and accurate communication and responding to data, business, and technology partners and peers in a timely manner.
* Provides updates to senior management, project stakeholders on the progress of the project and or assigned tasks.
* Reports weekly status to senior management and project team as applicable
* Conduct UAT testing when rolling out new regulatory filings or added data sources
* Identify, research, document and / or remediate exceptions
* Analyzes and verifies requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.

This individual:
  

* Must be comfortable working in a scaled agile development environment
* Have an ability to handle multiple requests from varied stakeholders, in a way that maintains clear priority, and ability to adjust when needed
* Be an effective “translator” of business needs into technical requirements
* Demonstrate an ability to build relationships, collaborate, and influence internal and external teams
* Be able to work under guidance of senior team member, take initiative, and get projects completed with great attention to detail and on time.

The experience you bring:
  

* A bachelor’s degree in finance, Business Administration, Information Technology.
* Minimum 5-6 years of business and data analysis experience
* Minimum 4-7 year of experience in the Investment Management industry/Asset Management/Financial Services industry.
* Strong scripting skills in programming languages like SQL and Python, as you will be responsible for writing queries and other data transformation scripts.
* Solid knowledge of Data Life cycle, data governance, data risk, Master data management concepts, data modeling, Business intelligence and analytics concepts.
* Ability to work in a team/group setting.
* Ability to interpret complex or vague instructions and successfully produce results.
* Proactively identifies, analyzes, and resolves procedural fail points.
* Demonstrates superior judgement, reasoning, and follow-up skills.
* Demonstrates a high level of initiative, assertiveness, and self-confidence.
* Proactively identifies and analyzes procedural improvements. Initiate projects/workflow that would enhance the department's functions.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office products
* Shares information efficiently between team members.
* Promotes Teamwork.
* Effectively manages multiple responsibilities and meets deadlines.
* An understanding of the concepts related to data modelling, coding and process flow design
* Excellent analytical, mathematical, and creative problem-solving skills
* Excellent listening, interpersonal, written and oral communication skills
* Logical and efficient, with attention to detail

**Full Time / Part Time**
Full time
  
  
**Worker Type**
Employee
  
  
**Job Exempt (Yes / No)**
No
  
  
**Workplace Model**
At Invesco, our workplace model supports our culture and meets the needs of our clients while providing flexibility our employees value. As a full-time employee, compliance with the workplace policy means working with your direct manager to create a schedule where you will work in your designated office at least three days a week, with two days working outside an Invesco office.
  
  
**Why Invesco**
In Invesco, we act with integrity and do meaningful work to create impact for our stakeholders. We believe our culture is stronger when we all feel we belong, and we respect each other’s identities, lives, health, and well-being. We come together to create better solutions for our clients, our business and each other by building on different voices and perspectives. We nurture and encourage each other to ensure our meaningful growth, both personally and professionally.
  
  
We believe in diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace where everyone feels equally valued, and this starts at the top with our senior leaders having diversity and inclusion goals. Our global focus on diversity and inclusion has grown exponentially and we encourage connection and community through our many employee-led Business Resource Groups (BRGs).
  
  
**What’s in it for you?**
As an organization we support personal needs, diverse backgrounds and provide internal networks, as well as opportunities to get involved in the community and in the world.
  
  
Our benefit policy includes but not limited to:
  

* Competitive Compensation
* Flexible, Hybrid Work
* 30 days’ Annual Leave + Public Holidays
* Life Insurance
* Retirement Planning
* Group Personal Accident Insurance
* Medical Insurance for Employee and Family
* Annual Health Check-up
* 26 weeks Maternity Leave
* Paternal Leave
* Adoption Leave
* Near site Childcare Facility
* Employee Assistance Program
* Study Support
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* ESG Commitments and Goals
* Business Resource Groups
* Career Development Programs
* Mentoring Programs
* Invesco Cares
* Dress for your Day

In Invesco, we offer development opportunities that help you thrive as a lifelong learner in a constantly evolving business environment and ensure your constant growth. Our AI enabled learning platform delivers curated content based on your role and interest. We ensure our manager and leaders also have many opportunities to advance their skills and competencies that becomes pivotal in their continuous pursuit of performance excellence.
  
  
**To Know More About Us**

About our Culture: https://www.invesco.com/corporate/en/about-us/our-culture.html
  
  
About our D&I policy: https://www.invesco.com/corporate/en/our-commitments/diversity-and-inclusion.html
  
  
About our CR program: https://www.invesco.com/corporate/en/our-commitments/corporate-responsibility.html

title: Workday PRISM & Reporting Product Lead
description:
Join Kainos and Shape the Future
  
  
At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.
  
  
We believe in a
**people-first culture**
, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.
  
  
Ready to make your mark?
**Join us and be part of something bigger.**
**Job Description**
As a Workday PRISM & Reporting Product Lead, you will be responsible for designing and building PRISM and complex Workday reports within our products for our clients. This will transform their Workday experience and provide complex insights into their data based on both customer requirements and our own best practices.
  
  
You will work as part of a delivery team responsible for cases for customers of all sizes, across multiple industries. You will be a lead within the Reporting & Analytics space and provide mentorship and oversight to more junior team members.
  
  
You will join the team with experience in the following areas: PRISM, Advanced, Matrix, Trending and Composite Reporting, Dashboards, Discovery Boards, Worksheets and building complex Calculated Fields. This role is vital in transforming customers’ Workday data into information that can drive their business decisions.
  
  
**As a Workday PRISM & Reporting Product Lead, you’ll have the opportunity to:**

* Conduct requirements gathering sessions with clients to understand needs
* Work with our Solution Architects and Product Manager on the design of the product
* Develop reporting solutions varying in complexity
* Design, configure, test, validate and migrate reports for clients
* Provide subject matter expertise on Workday best practice
* Contribute to internal Reporting & Analytics goals and initiatives
* Provide mentorship to more junior Consultants
* Work closely with other Reporting Consultants to configure unique solutions
* Maintain your Workday Certifications
* Gain knowledge in new Reporting & Analytics features

**We're Looking For Someone With**

* Workday HCM or Financials certification (PRISM certification preferred).
* 3+ years of Workday Reporting and PRISM experience, with strong expertise in Advanced, Matrix, Trending, and Composite Reports.
* Strong understanding of the Workday reporting framework, including Dashboards, Discovery Boards, Worksheets, and Report Writer.
* Experience with EIBs and data conversion .
* Broad Workday functional knowledge and the ability to translate business requirements into technical reporting solutions.
* Experience managing multiple stakeholders, prioritising workload, and delivering against SLAs and deadlines.
* Excellent customer-facing, communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.

**Desirable**

* Experience with Financials reporting, leading reporting projects, or Big Data technologies would be advantageous.
* Experience on projects with Extend applications

**Embracing our differences**
At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.
  
  
Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.
  
  
We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.

title: Automation Delivery Lead
description:
**Your Key Responsibilities**
Your responsibilities include, but not limited to
  
  

* Own enterprise automation delivery across Factory and non-Factory scope, while governing and progressively expanding the Automation Factory across additional platforms, capabilities, and business demand.
* Act as the primary internal interface with delivery partners, holding partners accountable for agreed scope, timelines, budget, quality, resourcing, contractual commitments, and knowledge transfer.
* Align business stakeholders, architecture, platform engineering, quality, security, operations, and other internal functions on priorities, dependencies, decisions, and solution readiness.
* Establish and govern delivery standards, lifecycle controls, reusable patterns, documentation, release expectations, and compliance with enterprise architecture, information security, GxP, validation, and data integrity requirements.
* Oversee demand intake, delivery-route assessment, roadmaps, prioritisation, capacity, major risks, dependencies, escalations, business adoption, and transition of solutions into sustainable operational support.
* Drive the onboarding of additional automation platforms and capabilities into the Factory model, using delivery performance, lessons learned, reusable assets, and business demand to scale the capability sustainably.

**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**

* 10+ years of experience in enterprise IT, application delivery, software engineering, platform delivery, or automation solutions.
* At least 5 years of experience with end-to-end accountability for complex technology delivery involving multiple stakeholders, platforms, and external delivery partners.
* Experience delivering enterprise automation solutions, ideally using Appian or comparable low-code, workflow, orchestration, or automation platforms.
* Demonstrated experience establishing, governing, and scaling a factory-based or comparable delivery model.
* Strong experience governing delivery partners, contractual commitments, service performance, delivery quality, risks, escalations, and knowledge transfer.
* Proven ability to align business, architecture, engineering, quality, security, and operational stakeholders on priorities, decisions, dependencies, and delivery readiness.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end technology delivery, including demand intake, requirements, solution assessment, design, build, testing, validation, release, adoption, and transition to support, using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid methods.
* Experience establishing delivery standards, lifecycle controls, reusable patterns, release governance, capacity models, and performance measures across Factory and non-Factory delivery.
* Knowledge of enterprise integration, APIs, workflow orchestration, information security, validation practices, GxP requirements, and data integrity principles.
* Strong communication, negotiation, influencing, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a global matrix organisation and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

**Why Sandoz?**
Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of good health.
  
  
With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably.
  
  
Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
  
  
  
  
#Sandoz

title: Assistant Vice President, Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions
description:
**About Citco**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 50 office locations worldwide. With more than $1.8 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.
  
  
For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com
  
  
**About The Team & Business Line**
Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.
  
  
Strategic Operations is a dedicated function within Private Assets. It brings transformation delivery, project execution, business analysis, operational initiatives and implementation support into one team, reducing the delivery burden on BAU Operations and maintaining ownership from design through adoption.
  
  
The group will be split across three distinct focus areas, aligned under two individual leaders:
  
  
Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions: led by the Operating Model & Product leader, this area will define how services should run end to end, shape scalable products and solutions, support complex client implementations, and ensure client commitments are operationally deliverable.
  
  
Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement: led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will define Operations requirements for data, reporting and platforms, strengthen data quality and lineage, and carry solutions through testing, deployment and adoption.
  
  
Digital Workflow, Automation & AI: also led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will identify and deliver workflow, automation and AI opportunities, establish appropriate controls, and measure whether the expected benefits are realised.
  
  
The group works in close partnership with Operations, the Transformation Office, IT, Tactical Operations and Marquee Client teams. Roles may be permanent or approximately 12-month rotational assignments anchored in strategic locations. Rotational colleagues will join from the business, help shape and deliver change, and return to the line with broader project experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Your Role**
**You will support the redesign and delivery of operating model and product change, with hands-on ownership of analysis, testing and implementation tasks.**

* Map current state processes, gather data and evidence where the friction and cost actually sit.
* Support the design of target state processes, controls and handoffs.
* Draft business requirements and supporting documentation for review with IT and the Transformation Office.
* Build and execute test scripts, run UAT cycles and track defects through to resolution.
* Document client-specific processes and requirements, and evidence where they differ from our standard model.
* Prepare analysis and materials to support client pitches, POCs and solution design.
* Support implementation of fund structures, new client setups, onboarding and transitions on our accounting platforms.
* Maintain the reuse inventory — what was built, for whom, and who else could benefit.
* Prepare training material and support Operations teams through go-live and into adoption.
* Maintain project documentation, trackers and status reporting.

**Qualifications**
**About You**
**You have 4+ years’ experience in private assets accounting or operations, at a fund administrator, fund manager or comparable environment.**

* Solid technical knowledge of private assets processes — general ledger, capital activity, fee calculations, financial statements and investor reporting.
* Exposure to process improvement, system testing or project work, or a clear appetite to move in that direction.
* Comfortable engaging both operational teams and technology partners.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interrogate data and evidence a recommendation.
* Attention to detail and a proven ability to manage several pieces of work at once.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Excel); exposure to reporting, workflow or automation tooling an advantage.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance or Economics; working towards a professional accounting designation an advantage.

**What We Expect Of The Strategic Operations Team**
Regardless of role or focus area, everyone in Strategic Operations is expected to demonstrate the following:
  
  

* Deep technical and operational knowledge — genuine depth in how our processes, data and platforms actually work — the detail that only comes from having run the work.
* Curiosity — the instinct to ask why a process looks the way it does, to challenge the answer, and to keep asking whether there is a better way.
* A transformational mindset — comfortable redesigning end to end rather than patching, and prepared to see change through past go-live to the point where it is genuinely adopted.
* Ownership through to adoption — accountability does not end at delivery; success is measured by whether the change sticks in the business.
* Commercial and client awareness — an understanding of what we can genuinely run, so that what we commit to a client is deliverable.
* Global mindset — working across regions, jurisdictions and time zones, and designing solutions that scale beyond a single desk, client or location.
* Ambition to shape Citco’s future — an appetite to help build the operating model we will run for years, and to be measured on whether it works.

**Our Benefits**
Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.
  
  
We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.
  
  
Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Gl.Assoc.Dir.Sol.Delivery Clinical&Med
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 This role will serve as a strategic technology partner to Clinical Development and Patient Safety stakeholders, driving digital transformation, business value realization, operational excellence, and AI driven innovation across the Clinical Development and Pharmacovigilance landscape.
   

  

 The role combines stakeholder engagement, technology leadership, solution architecture, application ownership, automation delivery, and operational support. The successful candidate will work closely with Clinical Operations, Clinical Data Science, Clinical Bioanalytics, Medical Writing, Regulatory, and Patient Safety organizations to design and implement scalable digital solutions supporting the end\-to\-end clinical development lifecycle.
   

  

 The individual will be a key member of the Clinical Development and Patient Safety Stakeholder Success Team, responsible for maximizing value from core platforms including Veeva Clinical Development Cloud and Veeva Safety Suite, enabling intelligent automation, driving technology roadmaps, and ensuring reliable delivery of business critical clinical and pharmacovigilance applications.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Your Responsibilities Include, But Not Limited To**
* Partner with Clinical Development and Patient Safety leaders to shape technology strategy and digital roadmaps.
* Lead implementation and support of Clinical Development and Patient Safety platforms, including Veeva Clinical Development Cloud, Veeva Safety, SafetyDocs, Signal, Workbench, and related ecosystem applications.
* Identify, design, and implement automation and AI use cases that enhance operational efficiency and business value.
* Provide hands\-on technical leadership for solution architecture, integrations, data flows, and cloud\-based clinical solutions.
* Drive end\-to\-end delivery of technology initiatives while ensuring compliance, quality, and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Collaborate with global cross\-functional teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable and innovative solutions.
* Support Patient Safety capabilities across pharmacovigilance processes including adverse event intake, case management, literature screening, signal management, aggregate reporting, risk management plans, PSMF, PV agreements, and regulatory compliance workflows.
* Mentor team members and contribute to the growth of the Clinical Development Stakeholder Success operating model
* Lead identification, prioritization, design, and implementation of automation opportunities across Clinical Development and Patient Safety.
* Build and govern automation portfolios
* Drive adoption of AI, GenAI, and intelligent workflow solutions.
* Measure and communicate business value realized through automation initiatives.
* Establish frameworks for responsible and compliant use of AI technologies in GxP environments


**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* 14 to 18\+ years of experience, with at least 10\+ years in Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, or Life Sciences Industry.
* Proven experience supporting Clinical Development and Patient Safety organizations globally.
* Hands\-on experience with Veeva Clinical Development Cloud implementation, enhancement, and support.
* Strong knowledge of various products across clinical domain for ex. Veeva, LabVantage, cloud technologies (Azure, AWS), etc. will be an advantage
* Hands\-on experience with Patient Safety and Pharmacovigilance technology platforms such as Veeva Safety, SafetyDocs, Signal, Workbench, web intake, literature screening, adverse event processing, and safety reporting solutions.
* Demonstrated success delivering AI, GenAI, and Automation initiatives across clinical and pharmacovigilance processes.
* Experience operating within a Stakeholder Success Team model, combining business partnership, consulting, delivery, and operations responsibilities.
* Strong technical background with the ability to engage in solution architecture, integrations, data flows, automation frameworks, and cloud\-based clinical solutions.
* Experience leading global teams and managing strategic vendor relationships.
* Excellent executive stakeholder management and business consulting capabilities.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100\+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of good health.
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

 Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
   

  

**Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.
   

  

 \#Sandoz
   

  

**Skills Desired**
 Budget Management, Business Acumen, Influencing Skills, Performance Management, Risk Management, Service Delivery Management, Strategic Planning, Waterfall Project Management

title: Senior Solution Analyst, Technology SC (SAP IBP)
description:
**Join us in building the future of Sandoz.**
 Through STEP (Sandoz Transformation Enterprise Program), we are creating a unified, integrated digital core and simplifying our end\-to\-end ways of working. From SAP S/4HANA to Veeva, Workday, LabVantage, and beyond, you’ll help design and deliver future\-ready systems that drive global impact — enabling us to deliver affordable medicines to more patients worldwide.
   

  

**Summary**
 As part of STEP \- Global Digital Transformation Program, we are seeking an experienced SAP IBP Consultant with a strong background in Demand Planning (DP), Sales \& Operations Planning (S\&OP), and Supply Planning. The candidate should have hands\-on experience in end\-to\-end implementations, business process design, and solution delivery in SAP IBP.
   

  

 Major Accountabilities
   

  

 Implementation \& Solution Design
   

  

* Lead the delivery of SAP IBP solutions across Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, S\&OP, and Order\-Based Planning.
* Manage end\-to\-end project execution, ensuring alignment with scope, timelines, quality standards, and business objectives.
* Collaborate with Business Process Owners, Supply Chain stakeholders, and leadership teams to develop scalable SAP IBP solutions.
* Ensure solution designs adhere to global templates, governance standards, and industry best practices.
* Work closely with SAP S/4HANA, BW, Master Data, Integration, and Analytics teams to enable seamless planning processes.
* Review and approve functional designs, configurations, testing, and deployment deliverables to ensure solution quality and readiness.
* Provide governance across SIT, UAT, regression testing, and deployment activities, ensuring timely resolution of risks and defects.
* Maintain comprehensive project and solution documentation, including requirements, designs, testing artifacts, and operational procedures.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* Make sure IBP implemented within planned Time, Budget and Scope ad with expected Quality.
* Make sure Solution fit for a company strategy and aligned with business priorities.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Industrial Engineering, Biomedical Engineer, Business Administration, or related field; (Master’s degree is preferred)
* Certification in project management methods (Agile, ITIL, Prince 2, PMI) is a plus.
* Experience with Agile/DevOps methodologies; Certification is a plus


 Languages
   

  

* Fluent English required (oral and written)


**Experience And Skills**
* 12\+ years of experience in Supply Chain Planning, including 8\+ years in SAP IBP.
* Proven track record of leading end\-to\-end SAP IBP implementations and global rollouts.
* Strong expertise across SAP IBP Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, S\&OP, and Order\-Based Planning.
* Deep understanding of Supply Chain Planning processes, best practices, and SAP IBP solution design.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP IBP configuration, forecasting models, heuristics, planning operators, and customizations.
* Experience integrating SAP IBP with S/4HANA, ECC, BW/BW4HANA, and other enterprise applications.
* Experience managing large\-scale global programs, vendors, and system integrators.
* Experience overseeing solution quality, testing, release management, and deployment activities.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, touched the lives of almost 500 million patients last year and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, state\-of\-the\-art production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum and entrepreneurial spirit is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is encouraged!
   

  

 The future is ours to shape!
   

  

 \#sandoz
